fields.summary_ko.0: ASML (ASML) is the sole supplier of EUV lithography equipment, recording 12-month revenue of $43.4B (up 22.5% year-over-year), net income of $14.8B, and net profit margin of 34.1%, while maintaining a conservative capital structure with debt-to-equity ratio of 0.2x.
fields.summary_ko.1: SK Hynix (SKHY) recorded 12-month revenue of $201.2B (up 219.8% year-over-year), net income of $141.4B, and exceptionally high net profit margin of 70.3%, demonstrating ultra-high profitability driven by excess demand at premium prices for AI memory.
